Game Overview

At its heart, Cute Box is a adventure game about guide an adorable box through charming 2D mazes, collecting flowers and evading colorful foes. Navigate past tricky spikes in eight increasingly challenging levels. Reach the red flag to advance, balancing lighthearted challenges with strategic platforming fun.

How to Play

Playing Cute Box comes down to a simple loop. Guide an adorable box through charming 2D mazes, collecting flowers and evading colorful foes. Navigate past tricky spikes in eight increasingly challenging levels. Reach the red flag to advance, balancing lighthearted challenges with strategic platforming fun.
